subject.title: refactor(meeting-bot): extract browser meeting-bot core behind MeetingPlatformAdapter

question: Should `meeting-runtime` become a public plugin SDK contract now with only Google Meet validating it, or remain internal until the Teams adapter proves the permanent boundary?
rationale: Code inspection can assess mechanics, but it cannot determine the maintainers' compatibility commitment to a new 81-export plugin API before its second intended consumer exists.

options.title: Validate privately first
options.body: Keep the extraction behind an internal bundled facade, build the Teams adapter against it, and publish only the minimal seam proven by both platforms.

options.title: Approve the public contract
options.body: Land the current public surface with explicit maintainer ownership of its compatibility and a documented evolution or deprecation plan.

options.title: Split API publication
options.body: Land or preserve the internal extraction separately while pausing the public SDK barrel until cross-platform validation is available.

recommendation.title: Validate privately first
recommendation.body: Keep the extraction behind an internal bundled facade, build the Teams adapter against it, and publish only the minimal seam proven by both platforms.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged voice-stack series and this extraction show the strongest available ownership of the architecture and intended Teams follow-up.
